subject: Empty Node.js child process launch latency

methodology.child: The current Node executable starts with an empty -e program.
methodology.processShapes: run* starts the platform shell plus the empty Node child; runFile* and runStream start the empty Node child directly.
methodology.pairing: Node direct and node-cmd launches run sequentially; first position alternates each sample.
methodology.interpretation: node-cmd delegates to node:child_process. Differences near scheduler variation are not evidence that either wrapper makes the operating system launch a process faster.

dispatch.subject: JavaScript wrapper dispatch with node:child_process replaced by counter stubs
dispatch.calibration: Each API uses at least 100,000 calls per measured batch and calibrates up to 2,000,000.
dispatch.interpretation: This isolates JavaScript overload normalization, options handling, and result envelopes from operating-system process cost.
